message.event_description: IndiaFOSS is an annual Free and Open-Source Software (FOSS) conference organized with passion and commitment by the FOSS United community. It's not just a gathering; it celebrates software innovation and the people who make it happen. Whether you are a seasoned developer, an aspiring enthusiast, or someone with a passion for technology, IndiaFOSS invites you to join this vibrant community.

message.ticket_form_description:
* **Merch**: T-shirt add-on at ₹999. Hoodies will be available for sale at the venue for ₹1499 in limited quantities.
* **Refund Policy**: The FOSS United Foundation does not have a refund policy, but we do allow ticket transfers. Read the transfer details [here↗️](https://fossunited.org/refund-transfer-policy).
* Please reach out to us at **[indiafoss@fossunited.org](mailto:indiafoss@fossunited.org)** for any queries.
